Method of Attack: Forged MFA requests, automatic withdrawal of cryptocurrencies, email confirmation replacement
Impacted Systems: Chromium-based browsers (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave Browser, Opera), email accounts (Outlook, Yahoo, Google), cryptocurrency accounts (Kraken, Bitget, Coinbase)
Attack Vector: Malicious Google ads, documents with macros, Aurora stealer, Ekipa RAT
Indicators of Compromise: Forged device authentication dialogs, replaced email confirmations
